standard-dialogue.npc: Kuani! Someone's come to visit the birds!

standard-dialogue.text: If the player has completed 10 rumours and has not claimed the free whistle blueprint:

steps.npc: I've spotted you working hard to help the guild. How would you like a basic quetzal whistle blueprint to help you get back here in the future?

steps.player: I'd love one!

steps.npc: You'll need to use the blueprint to craft a whistle from a willow log. Make sure it works for you. There's no standard size whistle nowadays.
When you want to charge your whistle, be sure to bring some of those lovely meats you're gathering up here for the birds. If they eat well you'll get a lot more use out of them!

steps.player: Not right now, thanks.
Who are you?

steps.npc: I'm Pitri, though most of the others call me birdbrain.

steps.player: On account of the...?

steps.npc: The birds, yes. I just feel so at home amongst them... Though I am more partial to cooked food than the raw stuff they get.
Is there anything else I can help you with?

options.text: Can you teach me about the birds?

steps.player: Can you teach me about the birds?

steps.npc: Absolutely! Like many in Varlamore, we here at the guild use quetzals to help us move people and reports throughout the entire network of transport nodes.
We also have these handy quetzal whistles that allow us to call for one to take us back to the guild. They're pretty magical and work at very long ranges.

steps.player: Could I get my hands on one of those whistles?

steps.text: If the player has not completed 10 rumours:

steps.npc: Once you've become more settled in with us at the guild, absolutely.

steps.text: If the player has completed 10 rumours:

steps.npc: Sure! I have a blueprint set aside for you to grab when you're ready.

steps.player: So how do you motivate the birds?

steps.npc: Food, mostly. They're big fans of the raw meats that the hunters bring back with them. I'm worried they may be waiting to eat us, quite honestly!

steps.player: Well, they're certainly big enough to try.

steps.npc: Is there anything else I can help you with?

options.condition: If the player has a whistle in their inventory:

steps.player: Can you recharge my whistle?

steps.text: If the player has no raw hunter meats or Quetzal feed:
If the player has one raw hunter meat or Quetzal feed:

steps.npc: Sure thing!

steps.text: If the whistle is fully charged after exchanging raw hunter meat or Quetzal feed:

steps.npc: Looks like the birds are all full for now. Make them work a bit before feeding them again!

steps.text: If the whistle is partially charged after exchanging raw hunter meat or Quetzal feed:

steps.npc: There you go. Some whistle charges for you!

options.text: How do I get my hands on more whistles?
options.condition: If the player has claimed the free whistle blueprint:

steps.player: How do I get my hands on more whistles?

steps.npc: I can produce another blueprint for you, for a small cost.

steps.player: What sort of small cost?

steps.npc: 500 coins. These blueprints are my art, and before you say anything, 'exposure' is the last thing I want out here in the savannah.
Here you go, one whistle blueprint.

options.text: I've lost my perfected whistle. Do you have any spares?
options.condition: If the player lost their perfected whistle:

steps.player: I've lost my perfected whistle. Do you have any spares?

steps.npc: Someone found one just the other day and gave it to me in case someone came to claim it. Could it be yours?

steps.player: It's possible? Can I see it?

steps.npc: Of course!

steps.player: That notch in the tail, that scratch on the underside... Yes, it's mine! I can't believe it!

steps.npc: Here you go! I'm afraid it has no charges left, though.

steps.player: Thank you!

options.text: Can I get a whistle with unlimited charges?

steps.player: Can I get a whistle with unlimited charges?

steps.npc: I see you already have a Perfected quetzal whistle, I can upgrade it for you at a cost.

steps.player: How much is this going to set me back.

steps.npc: I don't want your coins. Instead, I would like 10,000 charges worth of food for the birds here. You can give that to me piece by piece as well if need be.

steps.player: That sounds good to me, I have some food for the birds right here.

steps.prompt: Give Pitri food for the birds?

steps.text: If the player turns in less than 10,000 charges worth of meat:

steps.npc: Thanks for the feed, you still need to give me another [number] charges worth of food for the birds.

steps.text: If the player has turned in 10,000 charges worth of meat:

steps.npc: Thanks for all the food, I'll be glad to give you a whistle with infinite charges. The first one is free of course, any more will cost you though.

options.text: I have some more food for the birds.

steps.player: I have some more food for the birds.

steps.prompt: Give Pitri food for the birds?

steps.npc: Thanks for all the food, I'll be glad to give you a whistle with infinite charges. The first one is free of course, any more will cost you though.

options.text: Can I get a Perfected quetzal whistle with unlimited charges?
options.condition: If the player has received the perfected quetzal whistle(i):

steps.player: Can I get another Perfected quetzal whistle with unlimited charges?

steps.npc: I can produce another whistle for you, for a moderate cost.

steps.player: What sort of moderate cost?

steps.npc: 50,000 coins. These whistles are my art and not that easy to make. Plus a small fee for the charges.

steps.text: If the player has less than 50,000 coins:

steps.player: Ah, I can't afford one right now. I'll pop back later.

steps.text: If the player has at least 50,000 coins:

steps.npc: Here you go, one Perfected quetzal whistle with unlimited charges.

steps.player: I'd better be off.

standard-dialogue-choosing-the-recharge-.text: If the player does not have a whistle in their inventory:

steps.npc: Odd. You don't seem to have a whistle I can recharge.

standard-dialogue-choosing-the-recharge-.text: If the player has a whistle with no raw hunter meats/Quetzal feed in their inventory or if the whistle is fully charged:
If the player has at least one raw hunter meat or Quetzal feed to recharge their whistle:

steps.npc: There you go. Some whistle charges for you!

treasure-trails-hard.npc: Please solve this for me. I have other things to be thinking about.

treasure-trails-hard.text: Soar Leader Pitri has given you a puzzle box!

treasure-trails-hard-when-holding-the-pu.text: If the puzzle box is not solved:

steps.npc: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.

treasure-trails-hard-when-holding-the-pu.text: If the puzzle box is solved:

steps.npc: Thanks [player name]!

steps.text: Soar Leader Pitri has given you another clue scroll!

bT6Zxb.npc: Doesn't look like you've got anything I can feed to the birds here. You'll want to get some of the raw meats that the hunters bring back with them.
